metas.name: 1 · ★ 6.8 · 2015 · Gourmet Detective
metas.description: A culinary expert with crime-solving skills pairs up with a female detective to figure out how a guest at a distinguished dinner party died.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 6.8 · 2015 · Gourmet Detective: A Healthy Place to Die
metas.description: SFPD detective Maggie's up for vacation and gourmet detective Henry's speaker at a gourmet conference with a spare suite. Reporter Kathleen is murdered there - body missing. They investigate and banter.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 6.8 · 2016 · Death al Dente: A Gourmet Detective Mystery
metas.description: When Henry Ross is hired to find the best Italian chef for a new high-end eatery, murder was not on the menu. As the body count climbs, Henry and Maggie find themselves at the heart of another mystery with deadly consequences.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 6.8 · 2017 · Gourmet Detective: Eat, Drink, and Be Buried
metas.description: Henry and Maggie attend the birthday party of a local publisher, where his son and stepson reenact a historical 18th century dual. Someone, however, has loaded the antique pistol with a real musket ball, so when son pulls the trigger, he kills his stepbrother in front of a roomful of witnesses. Henry and Maggie have to figure out who wanted the stepson dead and why.

metas.name: 5 · ★ 7.1 · 2020 · Roux the Day: A Gourmet Detective Mystery
metas.description: Henry is hired to authenticate and purchase a long lost and very valuable recipe book. Soon Henry and Maggie find themselves in a murder mystery where secrets hidden within a treasured book have dire consequences for all who own it.
